summary: Retested the single fix from iteration_40: Chunk's 'Take your beat next door!' shout on /#/campus?zone=create when sessionStorage jma_just_saved_beat_v1==='1'. Fix VERIFIED. Regression smoke (Beat Lab left of Jam Session + jam-session badge) also PASS.

verified_fixes.bug: Chunk shout 'Take your beat next door!' never rendered on Create street after Beat Lab save (StrictMode double-invoke ate the one-shot).
verified_fixes.verification: Seeded localStorage (unlock-all, reveal-seen, player-name-skipped, audio-unlocked) + localStorage jma_saved_beats_v1 with one kick-only beat; set sessionStorage.jma_just_saved_beat_v1='1'; navigated to /#/campus?zone=create. Polled document.body.innerText every 200ms: 'Take your beat next door!' appeared at ~600ms (within 900ms timer window), sessionStorage flag was null immediately after it appeared (consumed inside the setTimeout callback — fix at CampusMapPage.js line 190). Text disappeared by ~2600ms (within the ~3.5s window — occasionally cut by the 1.6s random-shout clobber at 3.2s interval which is expected per prior notes). Reloaded the page WITHOUT re-setting the flag → shout did NOT re-appear during a 5s poll. Code review of lines 184-193 confirms: effect reads flag, bails if missing or wrong zone, schedules t1 (900ms) that consumes the flag + calls setShout, and t2 (4500ms) clears the shout. The removeItem is inside the t1 callback, so StrictMode's first mount's cleanup clears t1/t2 without consuming the flag; the second mount's effect still sees the flag and fires normally.

feature_checks.notes: campus-building-beat-lab x=386 < campus-building-jam-session x=864. campus-building-jam-session-badge text='1 to jam' with seeded single beat.

console_warnings: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — pre-existing warning (also reported in iteration_39/40), not introduced by this fix.

4x 'error:%c%d font-size:0;color:transparent NaN' — appears to be a styled console log emitted at error level by something in the page (likely dev instrumentation / posthog). Noise, not related to fix.
critical_code_review_comments: CampusMapPage.js:184-193 fix is correct: consuming sessionStorage inside the 900ms timer callback (rather than in the effect body) makes it StrictMode-safe. The cleanup only clears timers; the flag survives the first mount's cleanup so the second mount still schedules the shout. Clean and minimal.
